text:
maya: Quick check we need to finalize the console observability MVP scope for next quarter. Customers (ACME, Beta) want per-route spend, lightweight trace hooks for hotpaths, and error groups by model-version. Can we pick must-haves vs stretch today?

jon: I vote must-haves = per-route top-10 cost, toggleable per-route sampling (cap traces/min), and error grouping that surfaces model-version. Stretch = CSV export, per-model rollups.

rachel: Engineering note: trace hook plumbing is small but sampling UI and rate-limits need an extra sprint. If we cut, ship sampling via CLI first.

maya: Launch gates idea: cost within 10% of billing for sampled view, trace hooks live on top-3 routes, dashboard query p95 < 400ms. Rollback if cost delta > 20% or UI > 800ms.

jon: Rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with auto-fallback. Add alerting for cost spikes and error-rate regressions.

ops-bot: deploy started: obs-sampling-canary on infra-canary-7 (build 2026.88).

rachel: I'll add acceptance tests for fidelity and perf. Estimates in tracker by EOD.

maya: Thanks — scheduling a 30m huddle Thu 3pm to lock scope. Paste any ACME/Beta quotes here for the decision doc. :thumbsup:
